name: kinusaiga-thankyou
caption:
A Sunday Stitched With Soul, Art & Smiles! ✨🎨

We have successfully completed our much-awaited KINUSAIGA WORKSHOP and what a beautiful, heartwarming day it was!

From curious beginners to passionate artists, everyone came together to learn the magical Japanese art of creating pictures without stitching - just fabric and a lot of patience and love.

Watching you all create your first Kinusaiga pieces with so much focus and joy was the best part of my day. You didn’t just make art, you made memories.

A very special and heartfelt THANK YOU to all our lovely participants - your energy made this workshop a success. And a huge shoutout to the wonderful @_lakshitasingh_ for her amazing support, warmth and for making this event truly memorable and seamless.

This is what Strokes and Verses by Balpreet is all about - building a community where art heals, connects and celebrates.

Missed this one? Don’t worry, many more creative workshops are coming soon. Stay tuned!

With gratitude,
Balpreet
Strokes and Verses by Balpreet
